bitsmith_create.jei.mill.info: Cuts whole blocks into 4096 bits each, driven by rotation: at 16 rpm a block takes about 3 seconds, at 256 rpm a fifth of a second. Stress impact 4 per rpm. Blocks go in from any side (Create's chutes, funnels and belts, hoppers, storage buses), bits come out the same way. Right click with a bit bag to fill it. Comparators read how full it is.
